description: Internet Access is a dataset listed in OSBM Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by US Census Bureau. Presence and types of internet subscriptions in households as reported by the US Census Bureau, American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates. The year shown in the dataset referes to the final year of the five-year reporting period (ie "2019" refers to the 2015-2019 ACS). Coverage: North Carolina. The portal files it under Energy and Utilities. Its keywords are connectivity, broadband. The portal shows 7,800 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-10-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-linc-osbm-nc-gov-portal.
